series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, muted earth/stone/bronze midtones, deep ink-navy shadows)

scenes.shot_type: Thriving Bronze-Age Coastal Trade Caravan Overlooking Distant Volcanic Valyria (35mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm coastal trade-road wide: copper-laden ox-carts & Bronze-Age merchants above mudbrick port while unknown smoking volcanic peaks of Valyria brood across sea

scenes.shot_type: Uninhabited Basalt Sea-Cliffs & Smoking Cones of Pre-Historic Valyria (65mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm coastal telephoto: uninhabited black basalt cliffs, sulfur fumaroles & dark Fourteen Flames cones above wave-lashed black sand with zero buildings

scenes.shot_type: Early Bronze-Age Qaathi Wagon-Clans & Steppe Riders Across Northern Grasslands (50mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm steppe tracking wide: early Qaathi pastoralists in ochre-indigo wool & bronze chest-discs guiding hide-canopied ox-wagons through golden grasslands under storm sky

scenes.shot_type: Archaic Fisher-King of the Inland Silver Sea & Longboat Catch (35mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm shingle-shore wide: silver-circleted Fisher-King in fur-trimmed cloak beside brazier & cedar longboats as fishermen haul gleaming silver fish

scenes.shot_type: Willow-Draped Riverbank Bluff Opening Onto the Gentle Mother Rhoyne (24mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm willow-bluff ultra-wide: shadowed weeping-willow branches & natural mossy boulders framing golden afternoon waters, lateen skiffs & rose-sandstone pavilions of Mother Rhoyne

scenes.shot_type: Water-Level Expanse of the Mother Rhoyne With Giant River Turtle & Gilded Skiffs (24mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm water-skimming wide: giant mossy-shelled river turtle surfacing in ink-navy ripples before gilded lateen skiffs on endless golden-mist expanse of Mother Rhoyne

scenes.shot_type: Early Rhoynar Artisans & Elders on Spiral-Carved Rose-Sandstone Bridge (85mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm telephoto waterfront medium: olive-skinned Rhoynar potters & weavers in saffron-cream linen beside spiral-wave bridge carvings & sunlit lateen skiffs

scenes.shot_type: Rhoynar Lyre & Double-Reed Musicians Inside Open Rose-Sandstone Water-Pavilion (85mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm water-pavilion portrait: Rhoynar female lyre-player & bearded reed-piper in saffron-indigo linen framed by sandstone columns & glittering River Rhoyne

scenes.shot_type: Macro Study of Rhoynar Master Smith Hammering Glowing Wrought-Iron Bloom (100mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm riverside anvil macro: Rhoynar smith's tongs & hammer striking incandescent sparks from spongy wrought-iron bloom with turning waterwheel in soft bokeh

scenes.shot_type: Waterwheel & Conical Bloomery Iron Furnace Overlooking Mother Rhoyne City (40mm)
scenes.visual_beat: 65mm riverside terrace wide: two Rhoynar smiths tending roaring conical clay-and-stone bloomery iron furnace beside wooden waterwheel & golden-lit Rhoynar city
